# Description 📃

$2000 Number of Bounties: 2

Bounty Description Do you have an idea for a decentralized blog platform, news portal, educational hub, journaling or notes taking application? Or maybe you are building a knowledge base for recording science experiments? Use ComposeDB to build an application that utilizes information graph!

## Acceptance Criteria 🏁

  • Must use ComposeDB on Ceramic

  • Must be in knowledge management field

  • At least one new data model created or at least one existing data model re-used for the application

  • Judging will lean towards the completeness of the application: is the project in a concept state or ready to scale

  • Impact to Ceramic developer ecosystem

## Reward Pool 💸 USDC **4000**
title: Ceramic: Best knowledge management applications built on ComposeDB
